description: Express.js route definitions for development endpoints, including database status, seeding data, and verification functions for a MongoDB-backed application.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/db-status
methods.description: Returns MongoDB connection status including host, database name, and connection state.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed
methods.description: Seeds database collections with sample data if they are empty, and returns counts and sample documents.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/verify
methods.description: Verifies data availability by returning counts and sample documents from collections.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed-llm-costs
methods.description: Seeds 90 days of LLM cost data for specific models if collection is empty, and returns seed info.
